entries.2f12eee9edc4dbe7: The company’s corporate philosophy is “Devoting Ourselves to Human Health and Spiritual Richness,” and its basic policy is “Contributing to the Development of Japanese Food Culture and Izakaya Culture.” In its stores, the company focuses on a concept of “popular kappo,” offering handmade dishes by skilled cooks and an upscale atmosphere and service at affordable prices, and it operates nationwide mainly under the Shoya and Daisho Suisan brands, while also working on developing new “specialty store” formats. The company also states that its basic policy is “cash flow management,” aiming for a stable earnings structure and a solid financial base. For ingredients, it sets out efforts toward food safety and security, including clarifying production areas and traceability and conducting safety checks under the “Daisho Standard.”

entries.c3e7155653589029: The company’s advantage lies in its handmade Japanese cuisine and “popular kappo” concept, together with its in-house system for food safety and security.
